purpose: Teach: アドベンチャー/ヒルトン/ハーレム/エイリアン/ゴルファー/トークショー/東映/バイエルン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアドベンチャー絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to read you an adventure picture book.
lines.style: Soft, warm tone with a gentle smile in the voice. Speaking as if sharing a pleasant surprise. Even pacing, slight lift on the final clause. The affection of someone relaying good news to a child she cares for.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとヒルトンホテルに泊まったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to stay at a Hilton Hotel with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, excited burst on the opening. Quick pace, words tumbling over themselves. Seeking approval and recognition. Small-child enthusiasm — genuine and unfiltered, eyes wide with the bigness of the experience.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ハーレム作品は子供向けじゃないからね
lines.en: Sho, harem stories aren't for kids, okay?
lines.style: Gentle but clear boundary-setting. Warm still, not scolding. A pause before 'okay' — giving him space to understand. The tone of someone protecting without making him feel ashamed. Patient firmness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとエイリアンのアニメ観たいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to watch an Alien anime with Dad!
lines.style: Longing, hopeful pitch upward at the end. Slightly breathless with wanting. Testing — does she think this one is okay? Small voice carrying a big request. Genuine interest, not defiance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがゴルファーの先生にお会いになるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to meet with a golf instructor.
lines.style: Steady, informative tone. Casual sharing of a fact. Warm undertone but matter-of-fact delivery. No particular emphasis — just relaying what she's heard. Comfortable silence possible after.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとトークショー観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I watched a talk show with Dad!
lines.style: Proud, reporting-back energy. Slightly slower than the first excited line — more deliberate, savoring the memory. Wanting her to know he listened, he went, he was there. Small-child dignity in sharing what he did.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが東映の時代劇に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is taking you to see a Toei period drama.
lines.style: Warm, slightly delighted tone. Sharing something special. Even pacing, slight rise on 'Toei period drama' — marking it as an event. The voice of someone pleased to be the messenger of good things.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとバイエルンの試合観たいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to watch a Bayern match with Dad!
lines.style: Eager, building excitement toward the end. Slightly faster tempo. The 'want' lands with clear desire — not demanding, but expressing genuine hope. Softer close, seeking her agreement or support.
